text:
elena: quick heads-up — starting soft deprec rollout v1->v2 for the mid-market cohort tomorrow 9:00 PT. console will show banner + version badge. we found ~2% of requests have their version header stripped by our edge proxy. need decision on routing fallback and quota attribution before flip.
aj: do we have a telemetry signal id for that header-strip? can we detect and attribute reliably?
miriam: yes, we saw header-strip grouped by client IP + request-id pattern. noisy but identifiable. option A: route header-stripped requests to v1 (conservative). option B: route to v2 but bill against v1 quota (prevents quota jump). option C: route to v2 and bill to v2 (simplest).
kevin: option B worries me — double billing risk if clients retry with header later. we'd need idempotency dedupe in billing. also console graphs will look weird (tokens served != quota consumed).
sasha: on console UX: if we pick B we should show a “mapped quota” line and a tooltip explaining why numbers differ. otherwise support tickets will spike.
elena: agreed. telemetry team proposed a pragmatic hybrid: route to v2 (so clients see v2 behavior immediately) but mark events with "legacy_quota_source":"v1" when header missing. then a nightly job will reconcile billing to avoid double-charges. sampling rate 1.0 -> 0.1 for noisy clients to reduce signal noise.
aj: can you paste the proposed routing policy snippet? need to validate in staging.
elena: paste from staging config:
```
route_policy:
  - match: header_exists("X-Client-Version")
    route: use_header
  - match: not header_exists("X-Client-Version") and proxy_strip_detected
    route: v2
    annotations:
      legacy_quota_source: v1
      telemetry_sample_rate: 0.1
  - else:
    route: v1
```
miriam: small ask — ensure the reconciler emits a reconciliation flag per-tenant so billing can present a single line item (no surprise invoices).
kevin: also add a console anomaly alert (pager) if reconciler backlog > 1M tokens for > 2 hours.
elena: good point. i'll add backlog alert to runbook. @deploy-bot can we schedule the rollout but gate the flip on the reconciler health metric and the backlog alert being green?
deploy-bot: rollout scheduled: 2026-03-24T16:00:00Z -> canary 5% for 30m. gating checks: reconciler_health == OK, reconciler_backlog_tokens < 1_000_000. will abort and rollback if alert fires.
sasha: copy — i'll update the console tooltip copy and add a small explainer doc for support.
aj: action items:
- elena: add reconciler health gate + backlog alert (owner)
- miriam: add billed reconciliation flag in billing events (owner)
- kevin: add dedupe proof for reconciler to avoid double billing (owner)
- sasha: console tooltip + FAQ (owner)
elena: thanks — will post a final checklist tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
